text:
elaine: quick 15m 1: need final scope for enterprise compliance pilot. topics: audit retention tiers, BYOK/KMS path, SOC2/ISO evidence bundle, search/export SLAs. who owns the final decision?

sam: i'll own tech tradeoffs. reality: making multi-year logs searchable is costly. propose tiers: hot (searchable), warm (restorable), cold (export-only).

nisha: security: BYOK onboarding + key revocation/escrow are the riskiest. recommend gated pilot: BYOK onboarding + attestation; escrow only if customer requires it and legal signs off. include hash-chain integrity for logs.

william: field ask: two prospects want 7yr immutable logs + BYOK. willing to pay. timeline: pilot in 8 weeks ideal.

maria: infra: default policy -> 90d hot, 2yr warm (restore SLA <=4h), 7yr cold archive (export). searchable SLA only on hot. warm search opt-in for a fee.

jen: legal: need contract language for opt-in searchable warm tier, key custody liability, and export egress terms. i can draft.

elaine: MVP proposal: 1) BYOK onboarding + rotation docs, 2) audit export API + signed archives, 3) retention buckets 90d/2yr/7yr, 4) SOC2 evidence export for 30-day window, 5) hot search only.

sam: sample export API:
GET /tenant/{id}/audit/export?start=...&end=...
200 -> signed_url to encrypted archive (region-local)

nisha: acceptance criteria for pilot: BYOK onboarding validated with at least one customer, exported SOC2 bundle matches control mapping, immutability proof for hot writes, and key rotation tested.

william: sales will prepare pilot materials + pricing. i'll own pilot recruitment and comms.

maria: ops cost estimate: indexing + hot storage ~+25% for pilot with 2 customers; restore/exports extra ops. finance sign-off needed.

elaine: actions:
- sam: tech design + perf numbers by Tue
- nisha: compliance checklist + integrity tests by Wed
- william: sales one-pager + pilot list by Wed EOD
- maria: ops cost model + restore runbook by Thu
- jen: opt-in legal language + key liability by Thu
- elaine: assemble launch criteria & decision block Fri

devops-bot: FYI deploy freeze Thu 02:00-06:00 UTC 1 avoid infra merges during pilot prep :robot_face: 

sam: Q: can warm be turned searchable on-demand (customer pays)? that would meet enterprise asks without full-time indexing.

nisha: yes if legal signs SLA and we document RTO/RPO impacts. recommend opt-in flag at tenant level and explicit consent flow.

jen: will draft breach/revocation steps for keys and a rollback plan for compromised keys.

elaine: consensus = phased pilot: BYOK onboarding + retention tiers; search guaranteed on hot, warm searchable via opt-in. i'll circulate the acceptance doc after updates. thanks! :raised_hands:
